Mobile Phone lo use cheyyatam:
• Map meeda state ni tap cheyyi → panel opens
• Tabs switch cheyyadaniki swipe cheyyi or tab buttons click
• Map zoom cheyyadaniki 2 fingers pinch/spread
• Chrome browser best works
• Home screen ki add cheyyadaniki: Chrome menu → "Add to Home Screen"
💻
Laptop / Desktop lo use cheyyatam:
• Map meeda state ni click cheyyi → panel opens
• State name search bar lo type cheyyi (top left)
• Panel ni close cheyyadaniki EXIT button click
• Zoom cheyyadaniki scroll wheel use cheyyi
• Full screen ki F11 press cheyyi for best experience
🖥️
Best Settings / Tips:
• Browser: Chrome / Edge → best performance
• Screen: 75-100% zoom lo best kanipisthundi
• Voice feature: headphones use cheyyandi better ga
• Offline work: File save chesthe works without internet
• Bookmark cheyyi → roju study easy avutundi
⌨️
Keyboard Shortcuts (Laptop):
• Ctrl + F → browser lo search cheyyi
• F11 → Full screen mode
• Esc → Full screen exit
• Ctrl + +/- → Browser zoom in/out
• Ctrl + 0 → Default zoom reset
💡
Pro Tips for SSC Preparation:
• Daily 2-3 states complete cheyyi
• Test tab lo cheyyi → weak points identify cheyyi
• One-liners exam ki last week lo revise cheyyi
• My Stars lo important states bookmark cheyyi
• Exam Mode lo timed practice cheyyandi
